        f"Due: `{chat.due_date or '-'}`",
        f"- Assignees: {assignees}",
        f"- Updated: {chat.updated_at}",
    ]
    if chat.description:
        lines.append(f"- Description: {chat.description}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _messages_markdown(chat: Chat, limit: int = MAX_MESSAGES_PREVIEW) -> str:
    """
    Render the tail of the visible conversation as a Markdown list.

    Args:
        chat: The task chat.
        limit: Maximum number of messages to show.

    Returns:
        Markdown list (or a note when there is nothing to show).
    """
    visible = [msg for msg in (chat.messages or []) if not msg.hide]
    if not visible:
        return "> No visible messages."
    tail = visible[-limit:]
    lines = [f"> Last {len(tail)} of {len(visible)} visible message(s)"]
    for msg in tail:
        content = (msg.content or "").strip().replace("\n", " ")
        if len(content) > MAX_PREVIEW_CHARS:
            content = content[:MAX_PREVIEW_CHARS] + "..."
        lines.append(f"- **{msg.role}**: {content}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def _load_kanban(chat_manager) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Load the project's kanban definition, tolerating any failure.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.

    Returns:
        The kanban dict, or an empty dict when it cannot be loaded.
    """
    try:
        kanban = chat_manager.load_kanban()
        return kanban if isinstance(kanban, dict) else {}
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.warning("project_manager: could not load kanban: %s", ex)
        return {}


def _save_kanban(chat_manager, kanban: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """
    Persist the project's kanban definition (the board/sprint catalogue).

    The ``version``/``tags`` envelope written by the project UI is preserved so
    the file keeps loading after an edit made by this tool.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        kanban: The kanban dict to persist (mutated to add the envelope keys).
    """
    kanban["version"] = kanban.get("version") or 0.1
    kanban.setdefault("tags", {})
    chat_manager.save_kanban(kanban=kanban)
    logger.info(
        "project_manager: kanban saved (boards=%d)",
        len(_boards_info(kanban)),
    )


def _kanban_boards(kanban: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    """
    Return the MUTABLE ``boards`` collection of a kanban definition.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict (mutated in place when ``boards`` is missing).

    Returns:
        ``kanban['boards']`` as a dict or a list (created when missing).
    """
    if not isinstance(kanban, dict):
        return {}
    boards = kanban.get("boards")
    if not isinstance(boards, (dict, list)):
        boards = {}
        kanban["boards"] = boards
    return boards


def _board_key(kanban: Dict[str, Any], name: Optional[str]):
    """
    Return the exact key of *name* inside ``kanban['boards']``.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict.
        name: Board name to resolve (case-insensitive).

    Returns:
        The stored key, or None when the board is not stored as a dict entry.
    """
    boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    wanted = (name or "").strip().lower()
    if not wanted or not isinstance(boards, dict):
        return None
    return next((key for key in boards if str(key).strip().lower() == wanted), None)


def _board_entry(kanban: Dict[str, Any], name: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Return the MUTABLE board dict stored for *name*.

    Handles both supported shapes of the ``boards`` collection (``name ->
    board`` dict, or a list of board objects), so the column helpers work on
    whatever the project file contains.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict.
        name: Board name to resolve (case-insensitive).

    Returns:
        The board dict, or None when the board does not exist.
    """
    boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    wanted = (name or "").strip().lower()
    if not wanted:
        return None
    key = _board_key(kanban, name)
    if key is not None:
        entry = boards[key]
        return entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else None
    if isinstance(boards, list):
        for board in boards:
            if not isinstance(board, dict):
                continue
            title = board.get("title") or board.get("name") or board.get("id") or ""
            if str(title).strip().lower() == wanted:
                return board
    return None


def _boards_info(kanban: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Extract a normalized list of boards from a kanban definition.

    Handles the ``boards`` collection being either a dict (name -> board) or a
    list of board objects, and columns being either a dict or a list. It never
    raises: an unexpected shape yields an empty columns list.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict returned by ``load_kanban``.

    Returns:
        List of ``{"name", "type", "is_sprint", "parent_id", "columns"}`` dicts.
    """
    boards = kanban.get("boards") if isinstance(kanban, dict) else None
    info: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    if isinstance(boards, dict):
        items = boards.items()
    elif isinstance(boards, list):
        items = [
            (
                board.get("title") or board.get("name") or board.get("id") or "",
                board,
            )
            for board in boards
            if isinstance(board, dict)
        ]
    else:
        items = []

    for name, board in items:
        board = board if isinstance(board, dict) else {}
        columns = board.get("columns")
        if isinstance(columns, dict):
            column_names = list(columns.keys())
        elif isinstance(columns, list):
            column_names = [
                col if isinstance(col, str)
                else (col.get("title") or col.get("name") or col.get("id"))
                for col in columns
                if col
            ]
        else:
            column_names = []

        board_type = str(board.get("type") or "").lower()
        is_sprint = board_type == BOARD_TYPE_SPRINT or bool(board.get("sprint"))
        info.append(
            {
                "name": str(name),
                "type": board_type or (BOARD_TYPE_SPRINT if is_sprint else BOARD_TYPE_KANBAN),
                "is_sprint": is_sprint,
                "parent_id": board.get("parent_id"),
                "columns": [c for c in column_names if c],
            }
        )
    return info


def _board_dict(name: str, entry: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build a JSON-ready view of a board catalogue entry.

    Args:

    Returns:

    entry = entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {}
    board_type = str(entry.get("type") or "").lower()
    is_sprint = board_type == BOARD_TYPE_SPRINT or bool(entry.get("sprint"))
    return {
        "name": name,
        "type": board_type or (BOARD_TYPE_SPRINT if is_sprint else BOARD_TYPE_KANBAN),
        "is_sprint": is_sprint,
        "description": entry.get("description") or "",
        "parent_id": entry.get("parent_id") or None,
        "columns": _column_titles(entry),

    columns = entry.get("columns") if isinstance(entry, dict) else None
    if isinstance(columns, dict):

    if isinstance(columns, list):

                title = column
            elif isinstance(column, dict):
                title = column.get("title") or column.get("name") or column.get("id")
            else:
                title = None
            if title:
                titles.append(str(title))
        return titles
    return []


def _task_states() -> List[str]:
    """
    Return the canonical task states (the ``Chat.status`` values).

    The states are owned by :mod:`codx.junior.planning_manager` and imported
    lazily: duplicating the list here would let the tool and the planning views
    drift apart, and a state that the UI cannot render is not a valid state.

    Returns:
        Canonical state names, in workflow order.
    """
    from codx.junior.planning_manager import STATUS_ORDER

    return list(STATUS_ORDER)


def _board_catalogue(kanban: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Index the kanban boards by their normalized (lowercase) name.

    A board name is also the folder name under ``.codx/tasks``, so lookups must
    be case-insensitive: ``bugs`` and ``Bugs`` are the same board.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict.

    Returns:
        Mapping of ``board name lowercased`` to its board info.
    """
    return {board["name"].strip().lower(): board for board in _boards_info(kanban)}


def _board_names(boards: List[Dict[str, Any]], only_sprints: bool = False) -> str:
    """Render the known board names (optionally only the sprint ones) for errors."""
    names = [
        board["name"] for board in boards
        if not only_sprints or board["is_sprint"]
    ]
    return ", ".join(names) or "none"


def _match_board(
    by_name: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], board: Optional[str]
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Return the board info for *board* (case-insensitive).

    Args:
        by_name: Board catalogue (see :func:`_board_catalogue`).
        board: Board name to resolve.

    Returns:
        The board info, or None when the board does not exist.
    """
    if not board:
        return None
    return by_name.get(board.strip().lower())


def _match_column(
    board_info: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], column: Optional[str]
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Return the column title as spelled on *board_info*.

    Args:
        board_info: The board the column must belong to.
        column: Column name to resolve.

    Returns:
        The catalogue spelling of the column, or None when it does not exist.
    """
    if not column or not board_info:
        return None
    wanted = column.strip().lower()
    return next(
        (
            title for title in board_info.get("columns") or []
            if title.strip().lower() == wanted
        ),
        None,
    )


def _match_state(status: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Return the canonical state for *status* (case-insensitive).

    Args:
        status: State name to resolve.

    Returns:
        The canonical state, or None when it is not a valid state.
    """
    wanted = (status or "").strip().lower()
    if not wanted:
        return None
    return next(
        (state for state in _task_states() if state.lower() == wanted),
        None,
    )


def _validate_board_name(name: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """
    Validate a board/sprint name.

    The name is also the storage folder under ``.codx/tasks``, so path
    separators, control characters and names starting with a dot are rejected:
    a task saved on such a board would land outside its own folder tree.

    Args:
        name: Board/sprint name.

    Returns:
        The stripped name.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the name is empty, too long or not a safe folder name.
    """
    name = (name or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise ValueError("name is required (board/sprint name)")
    if len(name) > MAX_BOARD_NAME_CHARS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"name must be at most {MAX_BOARD_NAME_CHARS} characters "
            f"(received {len(name)})"
        )
    if any(ch in name for ch in ("/", "\\", "\n", "\r", "\t")):
        raise ValueError(
            "name cannot contain path separators ('/', '\\') or line breaks: "
            "it is used as the storage folder under .codx/tasks"
        )
    if name.startswith("."):
        raise ValueError("name cannot start with '.'")
    return name


def _normalize_board_type(board_type: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """
    Normalize and validate a board kind.

    Args:
        board_type: ``kanban``, ``sprint`` (case-insensitive) or None.

    Returns:
        The canonical board type (``kanban`` when omitted).

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the value is not a supported board kind.
    """
    resolved = (board_type or BOARD_TYPE_KANBAN).strip().lower()
    if resolved not in VALID_BOARD_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(
            f"board_type must be one of {', '.join(VALID_BOARD_TYPES)} "
            f"(received '{board_type}')"
        )
    return resolved


def _new_board_entry(
    name: str,
    description: Optional[str],
    columns: List[str],
    board_type: str,
    parent_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build a kanban catalogue entry for a new board or sprint.

    The shape matches what the project UI writes in ``tasks/kanban.json``
    (``id``/``title``/``description``/``columns``/``active``/``last_update``) so
    the board is rendered without any migration. ``type`` states whether it is
    a regular board or a sprint.

    Args:
        name: Board/sprint name (also the storage folder name).
        description: Optional description.
        columns: Column titles to create.
        board_type: ``kanban`` or ``sprint``.
        parent_id: Optional parent board name.

    Returns:
        The board entry dict.
    """
    return {
        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "title": name,
        "description": description or "",
        "branch": "",
        "type": board_type,
        "parent_id": parent_id,
        "columns": [
            {"id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "title": title, "color": ""}
            for title in columns
        ],
        "active": False,
        "last_update": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    }


def _ensure_board_folders(chat_manager, board_name: str, columns: List[str]) -> None:
    """
    Create the storage folders of a board (best effort).

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager (resolves ``chat_path``).
        board_name: Board folder name.
        columns: Column folder names to create.
    """
    for column in columns or [DEFAULT_COLUMN]:
        try:
            os.makedirs(
                f"{chat_manager.chat_path}/{board_name}/{column}", exist_ok=True
            )
        except OSError as ex:
            logger.warning(
                "project_manager: could not create folder '%s/%s': %s",
                board_name, column, ex,
            )


def _move_board_folder(chat_manager, old_name: str, new_name: str) -> None:
    """
    Move the storage folder of a renamed board.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        old_name: Current board folder name.
        new_name: New board folder name.
    """
    old_folder = f"{chat_manager.chat_path}/{old_name}"
    new_folder = f"{chat_manager.chat_path}/{new_name}"
    if not os.path.isdir(old_folder) or os.path.exists(new_folder):
        return
    try:
        shutil.move(old_folder, new_folder)
        logger.info(
            "project_manager: moved board folder '%s' -> '%s'", old_folder, new_folder
        )
    except OSError as ex:
        logger.error(
            "project_manager: could not move board folder '%s' -> '%s': %s",
            old_folder, new_folder, ex,
        )


def _retarget_board_tasks(chat_manager, old_name: str, new_name: str) -> int:
    """
    Rewrite ``Chat.board`` (and the stored file path) after a board rename.

    Tasks are stored in a folder named after the board and each chat carries
    the board in ``Chat.board``; a rename must update both, otherwise the tasks
    become invisible on the renamed board.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        old_name: Previous board name.
        new_name: New board name.

    Returns:
        Number of updated tasks.
    """
    folder = f"{chat_manager.chat_path}/{new_name}"
    if not os.path.isdir(folder):
        return 0

    updated = 0
    for file_path in pathlib.Path(folder).rglob("*.json"):
        try:
            chat = chat_manager.load_chat_from_path(chat_file=str(file_path))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as ex:
            logger.warning(
                "project_manager: could not read task '%s': %s", file_path, ex
            )
            continue
        if (chat.board or "").strip().lower() != old_name.strip().lower():
            continue
        chat.board = new_name
        chat.file_path = chat_manager.get_chat_file(chat)
        chat_manager.store_chat(chat=chat)
        updated += 1

    if updated:
        logger.info(
            "project_manager: retargeted %d task(s) from board '%s' to '%s'",
            updated, old_name, new_name,
        )
    return updated


def _rename_board_entry(
    kanban: Dict[str, Any], old_name: str, new_name: str
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Rename a board catalogue entry, preserving its fields.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict (mutated in place).
        old_name: Current board name.
        new_name: New board name.

    Returns:
        The renamed entry, or None when the board does not exist.
    """
    boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    key = _board_key(kanban, old_name)
    if isinstance(boards, dict) and key is not None:
        entry = boards.pop(key)
        if isinstance(entry, dict):
            entry["title"] = new_name
        boards[new_name] = entry
        return entry
    if isinstance(boards, list):
        entry = _board_entry(kanban, old_name)
        if isinstance(entry, dict):
            entry["title"] = new_name
            entry["name"] = new_name
        return entry
    return None


def _rename_children_parent(kanban: Dict[str, Any], old_name: str, new_name: str) -> int:
    """
    Point the child boards of a renamed board to its new name.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict (mutated in place).
        old_name: Previous board name.
        new_name: New board name.

    Returns:
        Number of boards updated.
    """
    boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    entries = boards.values() if isinstance(boards, dict) else boards or []
    wanted = (old_name or "").strip().lower()
    updated = 0
    for entry in entries:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        if str(entry.get("parent_id") or "").strip().lower() == wanted:
            entry["parent_id"] = new_name
            updated += 1
    return updated


def _remove_board_entry(kanban: Dict[str, Any], name: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Remove a board catalogue entry.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict (mutated in place).
        name: Board name to remove.

    Returns:
        The removed entry, or None when the board does not exist.
    """
    boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    key = _board_key(kanban, name)
    if isinstance(boards, dict) and key is not None:
        return boards.pop(key)
    if isinstance(boards, list):
        wanted = (name or "").strip().lower()
        for index, board in enumerate(list(boards)):
            if not isinstance(board, dict):
                continue
            title = board.get("title") or board.get("name") or board.get("id") or ""
            if str(title).strip().lower() == wanted:
                return boards.pop(index)
    return None


def _clear_child_parents(kanban: Dict[str, Any], name: str) -> int:
    """
    Detach the boards whose parent is *name*.

    Deleting a board must not leave dangling ``parent_id`` references behind.

    Args:
        kanban: The kanban dict (mutated in place).
        name: Name of the removed board.

    Returns:
        Number of boards detached.
    """
    boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    entries = boards.values() if isinstance(boards, dict) else boards or []
    cleared = 0
    wanted = (name or "").strip().lower()
    for entry in entries:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        if str(entry.get("parent_id") or "").strip().lower() == wanted:
            entry["parent_id"] = None
            cleared += 1
    return cleared


def _append_column(
    entry: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], title: str, color: Optional[str] = None
) -> None:
    """
    Append a column to a raw board entry (both supported shapes).

    Args:
        entry: The board entry (mutated in place).
        title: Column title.
        color: Optional column color.
    """
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        return
    columns = entry.get("columns")
    if isinstance(columns, dict):
        columns[title] = {"title": title, "color": color or ""}
        return
    if not isinstance(columns, list):
        columns = []
        entry["columns"] = columns
    columns.append({"id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "title": title, "color": color or ""})


def _remove_column(entry: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], title: str) -> bool:
    """
    Remove a column from a raw board entry (both supported shapes).

    Args:
        entry: The board entry (mutated in place).
        title: Column title to remove.

    Returns:
        True when the column was removed.
    """
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        return False
    columns = entry.get("columns")
    wanted = (title or "").strip().lower()

    if isinstance(columns, dict):
        key = next(
            (name for name in columns if str(name).strip().lower() == wanted), None
        )
        if key is None:
            return False
        columns.pop(key)
        return True

    if isinstance(columns, list):
        for index, column in enumerate(list(columns)):
            if isinstance(column, str):
                column_title = column
            elif isinstance(column, dict):
                column_title = column.get("title") or column.get("name")
            else:
                column_title = None
            if str(column_title or "").strip().lower() == wanted:
                columns.pop(index)
                return True
    return False


def _board_task_count(
    chat_manager, board_name: str, column: Optional[str] = None
) -> int:
    """
    Count the tasks stored on a board (optionally only in one column).

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board_name: Board name to count.
        column: Optional column name to narrow the count.

    Returns:
        Number of matching tasks.
    """
    total = 0
    for chat in chat_manager.list_chats():
        if (chat.board or "").strip().lower() != board_name.strip().lower():
            continue
        if column is not None and (
            (chat.column or "").strip().lower() != column.strip().lower()
        ):
            continue
        total += 1
    return total


def _delete_board_tasks(
    chat_manager, board_name: str, column: Optional[str] = None
) -> int:
    """
    Delete the tasks stored on a board (optionally only in one column).

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board_name: Board name.
        column: Optional column name to narrow the deletion.

    Returns:
        Number of deleted tasks.
    """
    deleted = 0
    for chat in chat_manager.list_chats():
        if (chat.board or "").strip().lower() != board_name.strip().lower():
            continue
        if column is not None and (
            (chat.column or "").strip().lower() != column.strip().lower()
        ):
            continue
        try:
            chat_manager.delete_chat(chat_id=chat.id)
            deleted += 1
        except OSError as ex:
            logger.warning(
                "project_manager: could not delete task '%s': %s", chat.id, ex
            )
    return deleted


def _drop_sprint_from_tasks(
    chat_manager, sprint: str, board_name: Optional[str] = None
) -> int:
    """
    Remove *sprint* from every task sprint list.

    Sprint membership is stored on the TASK (``Chat.sprints``) and a task lives
    on its own board, so deleting a sprint board must clean the identifiers
    stored on tasks of other boards, otherwise cards keep pointing to a sprint
    that no longer exists.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        sprint: Sprint name to remove.
        board_name: Board whose tasks are being deleted (skipped, they go away).

    Returns:
        Number of updated tasks.
    """
    updated = 0
    for chat in chat_manager.list_chats():
        if board_name and (
            (chat.board or "").strip().lower() == board_name.strip().lower()
        ):
            continue
        if sprint not in (chat.sprints or []):
            continue
        task = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id=chat.id)
        if task is None:
            continue
        chat_manager.update_chat_metadata(
            chat=task,
            metadata={"sprints": [s for s in (task.sprints or []) if s != sprint]},
        )
        updated += 1

    if updated:
        logger.info(
            "project_manager: removed sprint '%s' from %d task(s)", sprint, updated
        )
    return updated


def _validate_task_location(
    kanban: Dict[str, Any],
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    column: Optional[str] = None,
    sprints: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Validate a task destination and return its canonical spelling.

    A task must never be stored on a board, column, sprint or state that does
    not exist: such a task would be invisible on the board it claims to belong
    to and would create phantom folders under ``.codx/tasks``. Every provided
    value is therefore validated against the project catalogue
    (``tasks/kanban.json`` plus the states exposed by
    :func:`_task_states`) and the resulting :class:`ValueError` lists every
    problem together with the available options, asking to create the missing
    board/column/sprint/state first.

    Values that are ``None`` are not validated: they are not being changed.

    flowchart TD
        A[board] --> B{exists in kanban.json?}
        B -->|no| E[problem: unknown board]
        B -->|yes| C{column exists on that board?}
        C -->|no| E2[problem: unknown column]
        C -->|yes| F{state is canonical?}
        F -->|no| E3[problem: unknown state]
        F -->|yes| G{every sprint is a known board?}
        G -->|no| E4[problem: unknown sprint]
        G -->|yes| OK[canonical board / column / sprints / status]
        E --> RAISE[ValueError listing the problems]
        E2 --> RAISE
        E3 --> RAISE
        E4 --> RAISE

    Args:
        kanban: The project kanban definition (``ChatManager.load_kanban``).
        board: Target board name (``None`` = not being changed).
        column: Target column name (``None`` = not being changed).
        sprints: Target sprint list (``None`` = not being changed).
        status: Target task state (``None`` = not being changed).

    Returns:
        Dict with the canonical ``board``, ``column``, ``sprints`` and
        ``status`` (values that were not provided stay ``None``).

    Raises:
        ValueError: When any provided value does not exist. The message lists
            every problem, the available options and invites to create the
            missing board, column, sprint or state first.
    """
    problems: List[str] = []
    canonical: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "board": board,
        "column": column,
        "sprints": list(sprints) if sprints is not None else None,
        "status": status,
    }

    # -- state: closed set owned by the planning module ---------------------
    if status is not None and status.strip():
        matched_state = _match_state(status=status)
        if matched_state:
            canonical["status"] = matched_state
        else:
            problems.append(
                f"state '{status}' does not exist "
                f"(valid states: {', '.join(_task_states())})"
            )

    # -- board / column / sprint: catalogue from tasks/kanban.json ----------
    boards = _boards_info(kanban)
    if not boards:
        # A project without a kanban has no catalogue to validate against; the
        # call keeps working with the given names (states were checked above).
        if board or column or sprints:
            logger.warning(
                "project_manager: no boards in kanban.json, cannot validate "
                "board/column/sprints (board=%s column=%s sprints=%s)",
                board, column, sprints,
            )
    else:
        by_name = _board_catalogue(kanban=kanban)

        board_info = None
        if board:
            board_info = _match_board(by_name=by_name, board=board)
            if board_info:
                canonical["board"] = board_info["name"]
            else:
                problems.append(
                    f"board '{board}' does not exist "
                    f"(available boards: {_board_names(boards)})"
                )

        # The column is only validated against a resolved board: reporting both
        # "unknown board" and "unknown column" for the same call would be noise.
        if board_info is not None and column:
            matched_column = _match_column(board_info=board_info, column=column)
            if matched_column:
                canonical["column"] = matched_column
            elif not (board_info.get("columns") or []):
                problems.append(
                    f"board '{board_info['name']}' has no columns defined; "
                    "create the column first (action='create_column')"
                )
            else:
                problems.append(
                    f"column '{column}' does not exist on board "
                    f"'{board_info['name']}' (available columns: "
                    f"{', '.join(board_info.get('columns') or [])})"
                )

        if sprints:
            resolved_sprints: List[str] = []
            for sprint in sprints:
                sprint_info = _match_board(by_name=by_name, board=sprint)
                if sprint_info:
                    resolved_sprints.append(sprint_info["name"])
                else:
                    problems.append(
                        f"sprint '{sprint}' does not exist "
                        f"(sprint boards: {_board_names(boards, only_sprints=True)})"
                    )
            canonical["sprints"] = resolved_sprints

    if problems:
        raise ValueError(
            "Invalid task destination:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {problem}" for problem in problems)
            + "\nCreate the missing board, column, sprint or state first "
            "(action='create_board', action='create_sprint' or "
            "action='create_column'), then try again "
            "(action='list_boards' shows the current catalogue)."
        )

    return canonical


def validate_task_destination(
    chat_manager,
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    column: Optional[str] = None,
    sprints: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Validate a task destination against the project catalogue.

    Public entry point shared with the ``create_task`` tool: it loads the
    project kanban and delegates to :func:`_validate_task_location`, so both
    creation paths enforce exactly the same rules and neither can create a task
    in a phantom board/column/sprint.

    Args:
        chat_manager: Project ChatManager (reads ``tasks/kanban.json``).
        board: Target board name (``None`` = not provided).
        column: Target column name (``None`` = not provided).
        sprints: Sprint names to associate (``None`` = not provided).
        status: Target state (``None`` = not provided).

    Returns:
        Dict with the canonical ``board``, ``column``, ``sprints`` and
        ``status``.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When any provided value does not exist.
    """
    return _validate_task_location(
        kanban=_load_kanban(chat_manager),
        board=board,
        column=column,
        sprints=sprints,
        status=status,
    )

def _find_task(chat_manager, chat_id: str) -> Optional[Chat]:

def _action_list_boards(chat_manager) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    List the project's kanban boards, their columns, the sprint boards and the
    valid task states.

    Reporting the states here (and not only the boards) lets the model know
    what exists before trying to create or move a task, so an invalid value is
    avoided instead of rejected.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with a Markdown table (user) and JSON (model).
    """
    kanban = _load_kanban(chat_manager)
    boards = _boards_info(kanban)
    states = _task_states()

    if not boards:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=(
                "✓ No kanban boards defined yet. "
                f"Tasks will default to board '{DEFAULT_BOARD}' / "
                f"column '{DEFAULT_COLUMN}'.\n"
                f"- Valid states: {', '.join(states)}\n"
                "- Use action='create_board' (or 'create_sprint') to create one."
            ),
            llm_response=_json(
                {
                    "boards": [],
                    "states": states,
                    "default_board": DEFAULT_BOARD,
                    "default_column": DEFAULT_COLUMN,
                }
            ),
        )

    lines = [
        f"> {len(boards)} board(s)",
        "",
        "**Board** | **Type** | **Sprint** | **Columns**",
        "---|---|---|---",
    ]
    for board in boards:
        lines.append(
            f"`{board['name']}` | {board['type']} | "
            f"{'yes' if board['is_sprint'] else 'no'} | "
            f"{', '.join(board['columns']) or '-'}"
        )
    lines.extend([
        "",
        f"**Valid task states:** {', '.join(states)}",
        "",
        "> Use action='create_board' / 'create_sprint' / 'create_column' to add "
        "a destination, and action='update_board' / 'delete_board' to manage "
        "an existing one.",
    ])

    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(lines),
        llm_response=_json({"boards": boards, "states": states}),
    )


def _action_create_board(
    chat_manager,
    name: Optional[str],
    description: Optional[str] = None,
    columns: Any = None,
    board_type: Optional[str] = None,
    parent_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Create a kanban board or a sprint in the project catalogue.

    A sprint is a board whose ``type`` is ``sprint``; tasks belong to it through
    ``Chat.sprints``. The entry is written to ``tasks/kanban.json`` (the same
    file the UI writes) and the storage folders are created, so the new
    destination can be used immediately by ``create_task`` / ``update_task``.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        name: Board/sprint name (required).
        description: Optional description.
        columns: Column titles to create (defaults: ``tasks`` for a board,
            ``To do``/``Doing``/``Done`` for a sprint).
        board_type: ``kanban`` (default) or ``sprint``.
        parent_id: Optional parent board name.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the created board.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the name is invalid/already used, the type is not
            supported or the parent board does not exist.
    """
    board_name = _validate_board_name(name)
    resolved_type = _normalize_board_type(board_type)

    kanban = _load_kanban(chat_manager)
    boards = _boards_info(kanban)
    by_name = _board_catalogue(kanban=kanban)

    if _match_board(by_name=by_name, board=board_name):
        raise ValueError(
            f"board '{board_name}' already exists "
            f"(available boards: {_board_names(boards)})"
        )

    parent = None
    if parent_id:
        parent_info = _match_board(by_name=by_name, board=parent_id)
        if parent_info is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"parent board '{parent_id}' does not exist "
                f"(available boards: {_board_names(boards)})"
            )
        parent = parent_info["name"]

    defaults = (
        DEFAULT_SPRINT_COLUMNS if resolved_type == BOARD_TYPE_SPRINT
        else DEFAULT_KANBAN_COLUMNS
    )
    titles: List[str] = []
    for title in (_to_list(columns) or defaults):
        if title not in titles:
            titles.append(title)

    entry = _new_board_entry(
        name=board_name,
        description=description,
        columns=titles,
        board_type=resolved_type,
        parent_id=parent,
    )

    raw_boards = _kanban_boards(kanban)
    if isinstance(raw_boards, list):
        entry["name"] = board_name
        raw_boards.append(entry)
    else:
        raw_boards[board_name] = entry

    _save_kanban(chat_manager=chat_manager, kanban=kanban)
    _ensure_board_folders(
        chat_manager=chat_manager, board_name=board_name, columns=titles
    )

    is_sprint = resolved_type == BOARD_TYPE_SPRINT
    logger.info(
        "project_manager: created %s '%s' (columns=%s parent=%s)",
        resolved_type, board_name, titles, parent,
    )

    user_lines = [
        f"✅ {'Sprint' if is_sprint else 'Board'} created: **{board_name}**",
        f"- Type: `{resolved_type}`",
        f"- Columns: {', '.join(f'`{title}`' for title in titles)}",
    ]
    if parent:
        user_lines.append(f"- Parent board: `{parent}`")
    if is_sprint:
        user_lines.append(
            f"- Associate tasks with `sprint='{board_name}'` "
            "(action='create_task' / action='update_task')."
        )
    else:
        user_lines.append(
            f"- Create tasks on it with `board='{board_name}'` "
            "(action='create_task')."
        )

    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(user_lines),
        llm_response=_json(
            {"status": "created", "board": _board_dict(board_name, entry)}
        ),
    )


def _action_update_board(
    chat_manager,
    board: Optional[str],
    new_name: Optional[str] = None,
    description: Optional[str] = None,
    board_type: Optional[str] = None,
    parent_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Update a board or sprint: rename it, change its type, description or parent.

    Renaming is the delicate case: the board name is both the catalogue key and
    the storage folder under ``.codx/tasks``, and every task stores it in
    ``Chat.board``. The rename therefore moves the folder and rewrites the
    tasks, keeping the board usable afterwards.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board: Current board/sprint name (required).
        new_name: New name (optional).
        description: New description (optional).
        board_type: New kind (``kanban``/``sprint``, optional).
        parent_id: New parent board name (optional, empty string detaches).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the updated board.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the board does not exist, nothing is provided, the new
            name is invalid/taken or the parent does not exist.
    """
    board_name = (board or "").strip()
    if not board_name:
        raise ValueError("board is required for action='update_board'")
    if all(value is None for value in (new_name, description, board_type, parent_id)):
        raise ValueError(
            "Nothing to update: provide at least one of new_name, description, "
            "board_type or parent_id (use action='create_column' to add columns)"
        )

    kanban = _load_kanban(chat_manager)
    info = _match_board(by_name=_board_catalogue(kanban=kanban), board=board_name)
    if info is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"board '{board_name}' does not exist "
            f"(available boards: {_board_names(_boards_info(kanban))})"
        )

    current_name = info["name"]
    entry = _board_entry(kanban=kanban, name=current_name)
    changed: List[str] = []
    renamed_tasks = 0
    resolved_name = current_name

    if new_name is not None:
        resolved_name = _validate_board_name(new_name)
        if resolved_name.strip().lower() != current_name.strip().lower():
            if _match_board(
                by_name=_board_catalogue(kanban=kanban), board=resolved_name
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"board '{resolved_name}' already exists "
                    f"(available boards: {_board_names(_boards_info(kanban))})"
                )
            _move_board_folder(
                chat_manager=chat_manager, old_name=current_name, new_name=resolved_name
            )
            _rename_board_entry(
                kanban=kanban, old_name=current_name, new_name=resolved_name
            )
            renamed_tasks = _retarget_board_tasks(
                chat_manager=chat_manager, old_name=current_name, new_name=resolved_name
            )
            # Child boards pointing to the renamed board must follow it.
            _rename_children_parent(
                kanban=kanban, old_name=current_name, new_name=resolved_name
            )
            entry = _board_entry(kanban=kanban, name=resolved_name)
            changed.append("name")

    if description is not None and isinstance(entry, dict):
        entry["description"] = description
        changed.append("description")

    if board_type is not None and isinstance(entry, dict):
        entry["type"] = _normalize_board_type(board_type)
        changed.append("type")

    if parent_id is not None and isinstance(entry, dict):
        parent = (parent_id or "").strip()
        if parent:
            parent_info = _match_board(
                by_name=_board_catalogue(kanban=kanban), board=parent
            )
            if parent_info is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"parent board '{parent}' does not exist "
                    f"(available boards: {_board_names(_boards_info(kanban))})"
                )
            if parent_info["name"].strip().lower() == resolved_name.strip().lower():
                raise ValueError("a board cannot be its own parent")
            parent = parent_info["name"]
        entry["parent_id"] = parent or None
        changed.append("parent_id")

    if isinstance(entry, dict):
        entry["last_update"] = datetime.now().isoformat()

    _save_kanban(chat_manager=chat_manager, kanban=kanban)

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: updated board '%s' (fields=%s renamed_tasks=%d)",
        resolved_name, ", ".join(changed), renamed_tasks,
    )

    user_lines = [
        f"✅ Board updated: **{resolved_name}**",
        f"- Changed fields: {', '.join(changed)}",
    ]
    if "name" in changed:
        user_lines.append(f"- Renamed from `{current_name}` (folder and tasks moved)")
        user_lines.append(f"- Tasks retargeted: {renamed_tasks}")

    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(user_lines),
        llm_response=_json(
            {
                "status": "updated",
                "changed_fields": changed,
                "renamed_tasks": renamed_tasks,
                "board": _board_dict(resolved_name, entry),
            }
        ),
    )


def _action_delete_board(
    chat_manager,
    board: Optional[str],
    force: bool = False,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Delete a board or sprint from the project catalogue.

    A board that still holds tasks is never deleted silently: ``force`` is
    required, and it then removes those tasks too (their files live in the
    board folder). Deleting a sprint also removes its name from the
    ``Chat.sprints`` list of every task stored on other boards, so no card keeps
    pointing to a sprint that no longer exists.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board: Board/sprint name to delete (required).
        force: Delete the board even when it still holds tasks (default False).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing what was removed.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the board does not exist or still has tasks and
            ``force`` is False.
    """
    board_name = (board or "").strip()
    if not board_name:
        raise ValueError("board is required for action='delete_board'")

    kanban = _load_kanban(chat_manager)
    info = _match_board(by_name=_board_catalogue(kanban=kanban), board=board_name)
    if info is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"board '{board_name}' does not exist "
            f"(available boards: {_board_names(_boards_info(kanban))})"
        )

    resolved = info["name"]
    task_count = _board_task_count(chat_manager=chat_manager, board_name=resolved)
    if task_count and not force:
        raise ValueError(
            f"board '{resolved}' still has {task_count} task(s); move or delete "
            "them first, or call again with force=true to delete them with the board"
        )

    deleted_tasks = 0
    if force and task_count:
        deleted_tasks = _delete_board_tasks(
            chat_manager=chat_manager, board_name=resolved
        )

    removed = _remove_board_entry(kanban=kanban, name=resolved)
    detached = _clear_child_parents(kanban=kanban, name=resolved)
    # Sprint membership lives on the tasks of OTHER boards: clean it up.
    dropped_from = _drop_sprint_from_tasks(
        chat_manager=chat_manager, sprint=resolved, board_name=resolved
    )
    _save_kanban(chat_manager=chat_manager, kanban=kanban)

    if force:
        try:
            chat_manager.delete_kanban(kanban_title=resolved)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # A board without tasks has no folder: nothing to remove.
            pass

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: deleted board '%s' (tasks=%d detach_children=%d "
        "sprint_memberships=%d force=%s)",
        resolved, deleted_tasks, detached, dropped_from, force,
    )

    user_lines = [
        f"🗑️ {'Sprint' if info['is_sprint'] else 'Board'} deleted: **{resolved}**",
        f"- Tasks deleted: {deleted_tasks}" if force else "- Tasks: none (empty board)",
        f"- Child boards detached: {detached}" if detached else None,
        f"- Sprint membership removed from {dropped_from} task(s)"
        if dropped_from else None,
    ]
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(line for line in user_lines if line),
        llm_response=_json(
            {
                "status": "deleted",
                "board": resolved,
                "deleted_tasks": deleted_tasks,
                "detached_children": detached,
                "sprint_memberships_removed": dropped_from,
                "was_sprint": info["is_sprint"],
                "removed_entry": _board_dict(resolved, removed),
            }
        ),
    )


def _action_create_column(
    chat_manager,
    board: Optional[str],
    name: Optional[str],
    color: Optional[str] = None,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Add a column to an existing board or sprint.

    Tasks are stored in ``.codx/tasks/<board>/<column>``, so a column must exist
    on the board before a task can be created or moved into it.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board: Board/sprint name (required).
        name: Column title (required).
        color: Optional column color (as used by the UI).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the created column.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the board does not exist, the column title is invalid
            or the column already exists.
    """
    board_name = (board or "").strip()
    column = (name or "").strip()
    if not board_name:
        raise ValueError("board is required for action='create_column'")
    if not column:
        raise ValueError("name (column title) is required for action='create_column'")

    kanban = _load_kanban(chat_manager)
    info = _match_board(by_name=_board_catalogue(kanban=kanban), board=board_name)
    if info is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"board '{board_name}' does not exist "
            f"(available boards: {_board_names(_boards_info(kanban))})"
        )
    if any(ch in column for ch in ("/", "\\", "\n", "\r", "\t")):
        raise ValueError(
            "name cannot contain path separators ('/', '\\') or line breaks: it "
            "is used as the storage folder under .codx/tasks"
        )
    if _match_column(board_info=info, column=column):
        raise ValueError(
            f"column '{column}' already exists on board '{info['name']}' "
            f"(columns: {', '.join(info.get('columns') or []) or 'none'})"
        )

    entry = _board_entry(kanban=kanban, name=info["name"])
    _append_column(entry=entry, title=column, color=color)
    _save_kanban(chat_manager=chat_manager, kanban=kanban)
    _ensure_board_folders(
        chat_manager=chat_manager, board_name=info["name"], columns=[column]
    )

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: created column '%s' on board '%s'", column, info["name"]
    )
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response=(
            f"✅ Column created: **{column}** on board **{info['name']}**\n"
            f"- Columns: {', '.join(_column_titles(entry)) or 'none'}"
        ),
        llm_response=_json(
            {"status": "created", "column": column,
             "board": _board_dict(info["name"], entry)}
        ),
    )


def _action_delete_column(
    chat_manager,
    board: Optional[str],
    name: Optional[str],
    force: bool = False,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Remove a column from a board or sprint.

    A column that still holds tasks is never removed silently: ``force`` is
    required, and it then deletes those tasks too (their files live in the
    column folder).

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board: Board/sprint name (required).
        name: Column title to remove (required).
        force: Delete the column even when it still holds tasks.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the removal.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the board or the column does not exist, or the column
            still has tasks and ``force`` is False.
    """
    board_name = (board or "").strip()
    column = (name or "").strip()
    if not board_name:
        raise ValueError("board is required for action='delete_column'")
    if not column:
        raise ValueError("name (column title) is required for action='delete_column'")

    kanban = _load_kanban(chat_manager)
    info = _match_board(by_name=_board_catalogue(kanban=kanban), board=board_name)
    if info is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"board '{board_name}' does not exist "
            f"(available boards: {_board_names(_boards_info(kanban))})"
        )
    resolved_column = _match_column(board_info=info, column=column)
    if resolved_column is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"column '{column}' does not exist on board '{info['name']}' "
            f"(columns: {', '.join(info.get('columns') or []) or 'none'})"
        )

    task_count = _board_task_count(
        chat_manager=chat_manager, board_name=info["name"], column=resolved_column
    )
    if task_count and not force:
        raise ValueError(
            f"column '{resolved_column}' still has {task_count} task(s); move or "
            "delete them first, or call again with force=true"
        )

    deleted_tasks = 0
    if force and task_count:
        deleted_tasks = _delete_board_tasks(
            chat_manager=chat_manager,
            board_name=info["name"],
            column=resolved_column,
        )

    entry = _board_entry(kanban=kanban, name=info["name"])
    _remove_column(entry=entry, title=resolved_column)
    _save_kanban(chat_manager=chat_manager, kanban=kanban)

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: deleted column '%s' from board '%s' (tasks=%d)",
        resolved_column, info["name"], deleted_tasks,
    )
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response=(
            f"🗑️ Column deleted: **{resolved_column}** from board **{info['name']}**\n"
            f"- Tasks deleted: {deleted_tasks}\n"
            f"- Columns: {', '.join(_column_titles(entry)) or 'none'}"
        ),
        llm_response=_json(
            {"status": "deleted", "column": resolved_column,
             "deleted_tasks": deleted_tasks,
             "board": _board_dict(info["name"], entry)}
        ),
    )


def _action_list_tasks(
    chat_manager,
    board: Optional[str] = None,
    column: Optional[str] = None,
    sprint: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    query: Optional[str] = None,
    limit: Optional[int] = None,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    List the project's tasks with optional filters.

    Filters are not validated on purpose: filtering by a board/column/state that
    does not exist simply returns no tasks, which is a harmless way to discover
    that the destination is missing.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        board: Only tasks on this board.
        column: Only tasks on this column.
        sprint: Only tasks associated to this sprint.
        status: Only tasks with this status (case-insensitive).
        query: Case-insensitive substring matched against name and description.
        limit: Maximum number of tasks returned.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with a Markdown table (user) and JSON (model).
    """
    chats = chat_manager.list_chats()

    if board:
        chats = [c for c in chats if (c.board or "").lower() == board.lower()]
    if column:
        chats = [c for c in chats if (c.column or "").lower() == column.lower()]
    if sprint:
        chats = [c for c in chats if sprint in (c.sprints or [])]
    if status:
        chats = [c for c in chats if (c.status or "").lower() == status.lower()]
    if query:
        needle = query.strip().lower()
        chats = [
            c for c in chats
            if needle in (c.name or "").lower()
            or needle in (c.description or "").lower()
        ]

    chats = sorted(chats, key=lambda c: str(c.updated_at or ""), reverse=True)
    total = len(chats)
    if limit and limit > 0:
        chats = chats[:limit]

    if not chats:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="✓ No tasks match the given filters.",
            llm_response=_json({"count": 0, "tasks": []}),
        )

    lines = [
        f"> {len(chats)} of {total} task(s)",
        "",
        "**ID** | **Name** | **Status** | **Board/Column** | **Sprints** | **Updated**",
        "---|---|---|---|---|---",
    ]
    for chat in chats:
        sprints = ", ".join(chat.sprints or []) or "-"
        name = (chat.name or "(unnamed)").replace("|", "/")
        lines.append(
            f"`{_short_id(chat)}` | {name} | {chat.status or '-'} | "
            f"{chat.board}/{chat.column} | {sprints} | {chat.updated_at}"
        )

    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(lines),
        llm_response=_json({"count": len(chats), "total": total, "tasks": [
            _task_dict(chat) for chat in chats
        ]}),
    )


def _action_get_task(chat_manager, chat_id: str) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Read a single task: status, location, sprints and visible messages.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        chat_id: Task/chat id.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with the task summary and messages.
    """
    chat = _find_task(chat_manager, chat_id)
    if chat is None:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"❌ Task `{chat_id}` not found",
            llm_response=(
                f"Task '{chat_id}' not found. Use action='list_tasks' to find "
                "the available tasks."
            ),
        )

    user_response = "\n".join([
        _task_summary(chat),
        "",
        "**Conversation**",
        _messages_markdown(chat),
    ])
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response=user_response,
        llm_response=_json(_task_dict(chat, include_messages=True)),
    )


def _action_create_task(
    chat_manager,
    event_manager,
    current_chat: Optional[Chat],
    settings,
    name: str,
    content: Optional[str],
    description: Optional[str],
    board: Optional[str],
    column: Optional[str],
    sprints: Any,
    sprint: Optional[str],
    status: Optional[str],
    priority: Optional[str],
    due_date: Optional[str],
    progress: Optional[int],
    assignees: Any,
    profiles: Any,
    files: Any,
    tags: Any,
    parent_id: Optional[str],
    username: Optional[str],
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Create a new task chat associated to a board, column and sprint(s).

    The destination is validated BEFORE the chat is created: a task can only be
    created on an existing board, in an existing column of that board, with
    existing sprints and a valid state. Names are canonicalised to the
    catalogue spelling so the task is stored in the right folder. Missing
    destinations are created first with ``create_board`` / ``create_sprint`` /
    ``create_column``.

    Persistence is delegated to :class:`~codx.junior.task_manager.TaskManager`,
    the single creation core shared with the ``create_task`` tool and
    ``POST /api/chats/tasks``. Every field comes from the arguments: nothing is
    inherited from ``current_chat`` but the parent link and the project scope.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        event_manager: Event manager used to notify the UI (may be None).
        current_chat: The chat that triggered the tool (for parent/project).
        settings: Project settings (for project scope).
        name: Task name (required).
        content: Initial user instruction (defaults to description/name).
        description: Task description (required).
        board: Kanban board (defaults to ``kanban``; must exist).
        column: Kanban column (defaults to ``tasks``; must exist on the board).
        sprints: Sprint list to associate (each must be a known board).
        sprint: Single sprint to associate (merged with ``sprints``).
        status: Initial state (must be a valid state).
        priority: Task priority.
        due_date: Due date (ISO ``YYYY-MM-DD``).
        progress: Completion percentage (0-100).
        assignees: Usernames assigned.
        profiles: Profiles/roles for the task (parameter only, never inherited).
        files: Files related to the task.
        tags: Tags for categorizing the task.
        parent_id: Parent chat id (defaults to the current chat).
        username: Author username.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the created task.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When ``name`` or ``description`` is empty, or the
            destination (board, column, sprint or state) does not exist.
    """
    name = (name or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise ValueError("name is required to create a task")

    description = (description or "").strip()
    if not description:
        # Tasks are created with all their information: there is no AI step that
        # expands a short title into a task description anymore.
        raise ValueError(
            "description is required to create a task: provide the complete "
            "instructions (there is no AI sub-task generation anymore)"
        )

    # Validate (and canonicalise) the destination BEFORE creating the chat: a
    # task must never land on a board/column/sprint/state that does not exist.
    location = _validate_task_location(
        kanban=_load_kanban(chat_manager),
        board=(board or DEFAULT_BOARD).strip(),
        column=(column or DEFAULT_COLUMN).strip(),
        sprints=_normalize_sprints(None, sprints, sprint),
        status=status,
    )
    board = location["board"]
    column = location["column"]
    task_sprints = location["sprints"] or []
    status = location["status"]

    # Single creation core shared with the `create_task` tool and the API:
    # everything comes from the arguments, nothing is inherited from
    # `current_chat` but the parent link and the project scope.
    task_manager = TaskManager(
        settings=settings,
        chat_manager=chat_manager,
        event_manager=event_manager,
    )
    saved_task = task_manager.create_task(
        name=name,
        description=description,
        content=content,
        board=board,
        column=column,
        sprints=task_sprints,
        status=status,
        priority=priority,
        due_date=due_date,
        progress=progress,
        assignees=assignees,
        profiles=profiles,
        files=files,
        tags=tags,
        parent_id=parent_id,
        parent_chat=current_chat,
        user=username,
    )

    user_lines = [
        f"✅ Task created: **{saved_task.name}**",
        f"- ID: `{saved_task.id}`",
        f"- Board/Column: `{saved_task.board}` / `{saved_task.column}`",
        f"- Sprints: {', '.join(f'`{s}`' for s in task_sprints) or 'none'}",
        f"- Status: `{saved_task.status or '-'}`",
        "\nUse action='request_changes' to process this task through the engine.",
    ]

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: created task '%s' (board=%s column=%s sprints=%s)",
        saved_task.id, board, column, task_sprints,
    )
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(user_lines),
        llm_response=_json({"status": "created", "task": _task_dict(saved_task)}),
    )


def _action_update_task(
    chat_manager,
    event_manager,
    chat_id: str,
    board: Optional[str],
    column: Optional[str],
    sprints: Any,
    sprint: Optional[str],
    status: Optional[str],
    priority: Optional[str],
    due_date: Optional[str],
    progress: Optional[int],
    assignees: Any,
    tags: Any,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Update a task's status and/or move it between boards, columns and sprints.

    Metadata-only changes are delegated to
    :meth:`ChatManager.update_chat_metadata`, which keeps the messages intact
    and records a ``ChatStatusEvent`` whenever the status actually changes.

    The destination is validated BEFORE the chat is modified. Only the values
    being changed are validated, but a move validates the resulting location:
    when the board changes the current column is checked against the NEW board,
    so a task can never end up in a column that only exists on the previous
    board.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        event_manager: Event manager used to notify the UI (may be None).
        chat_id: Task/chat id.
        board: New board (must exist).
        column: New column (must exist on the resulting board).
        sprints: Full replacement sprint list (each must be a known board).
        sprint: Single sprint to append (used when ``sprints`` is None).
        status: New state (must be a valid state).
        priority: New priority.
        due_date: New due date.
        progress: New completion percentage.
        assignees: New assignee list (replaces).
        tags: New tag list (replaces).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the updated task.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the task does not exist, nothing is provided, or the
            target destination (board, column, sprint or state) does not exist.
    """
    chat = _find_task(chat_manager, chat_id)
    if chat is None:
        raise ValueError(f"task '{chat_id}' not found")

    sprints_changed = sprints is not None or sprint is not None
    new_sprints = _normalize_sprints(chat.sprints, sprints, sprint)

    # Validate (and canonicalise) the destination BEFORE touching the chat.
    # Changing only the column still validates the board it lives on.
    target_board = (
        board.strip() if board is not None
        else (chat.board if column is not None else None)
    )
    location = _validate_task_location(
        kanban=_load_kanban(chat_manager),
        board=target_board,
        column=(
            column.strip() if column is not None
            else (chat.column if board is not None else None)
        ),
        sprints=new_sprints if sprints_changed else None,
        status=status,
    )
    if board is not None:
        board = location["board"]
    if column is not None:
        column = location["column"]
    if sprints_changed:
        new_sprints = location["sprints"] or []
    if status is not None:
        status = location["status"]

    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if status is not None:
        metadata["status"] = status
    if board is not None:
        metadata["board"] = board.strip()
    if column is not None:
        metadata["column"] = column.strip()
    if priority is not None:
        metadata["priority"] = priority
    if due_date is not None:
        metadata["due_date"] = due_date
    if progress is not None:
        metadata["progress"] = max(0, min(100, int(progress)))
    if assignees is not None:
        metadata["assignees"] = _to_list(assignees)
    if tags is not None:
        metadata["tags"] = _to_list(tags)

    if sprints_changed and new_sprints != list(chat.sprints or []):
        metadata["sprints"] = new_sprints

    if not metadata:
        raise ValueError(
            "Nothing to update: provide at least one of status, board, column, "
            "sprints, sprint, priority, due_date, progress, assignees or tags"
        )

    updated = chat_manager.update_chat_metadata(chat=chat, metadata=metadata)
    _emit(
        event_manager=event_manager,
        chat=updated,
        message=f"Task '{updated.name}' updated: {', '.join(sorted(metadata))}",
        event_type="changed",
    )

    user_lines = [
        _task_summary(updated),
        "",
        f"- Changed fields: {', '.join(sorted(metadata))}",
    ]

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: updated task '%s' (fields=%s)",
        updated.id, ", ".join(sorted(metadata)),
    )
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response="\n".join(user_lines),
        llm_response=_json(
            {"status": "updated", "changed_fields": sorted(metadata),
             "task": _task_dict(updated)}
        ),
    )


def _append_comment(
    chat_manager,
    chat: Chat,
    content: str,
    role: str,
    profiles: Any,
    files: Any,
    username: Optional[str],
) -> Message:
    """
    Append a comment (message) to a task and persist it.

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        chat: The task chat (mutated in place).
        content: Comment content.
        role: Message role ('user', 'assistant').
        profiles: Profiles to stamp on the message.
        files: Files to stamp on the message.
        username: Author username.

    Returns:
        The persisted message.
    """
    message = Message(
        role=role,
        content=content,
        profiles=_to_profiles(profiles),
        files=_to_list(files),
        user=username,
    )
    chat.messages.append(message)
    chat_manager.save_chat(chat=chat)
    return message


def _latest_assistant_content(chat: Chat) -> str:
    """
    Return a short preview of the last visible assistant message.

    Args:
        chat: The task chat.

    Returns:
        The (truncated) assistant content, or an empty string.
    """
    for message in reversed(chat.messages or []):
        if message.hide or message.role != "assistant":
            continue
        content = (message.content or "").strip()
        if len(content) > MAX_RESULT_CHARS:
            content = content[:MAX_RESULT_CHARS] + "..."
        return content
    return ""


async def _action_request_changes(
    processing_session,
    chat_manager,
    event_manager,
    chat_id: str,
    comment: str,
    role: Optional[str],
    profiles: Any,
    files: Any,
    username: Optional[str],
    disable_knowledge: bool,
    wait: bool,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Add a comment to a task and process it through the ChatEngine.

    The comment is stored as the task's latest user message, then
    ``session.chat_with_project`` runs the engine so the task is actually
    processed. With ``wait=False`` the engine runs in the background (the
    coroutine is kept alive until it finishes).

    Args:
        processing_session: A session exposing ``chat_with_project``.
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        event_manager: Event manager used to notify the UI (may be None).
        chat_id: Task/chat id.
        comment: The change request (required).
        role: Comment role (defaults to ``user``).
        profiles: Profiles to stamp on the comment.
        files: Files to stamp on the comment.
        username: Author username.
        disable_knowledge: Skip knowledge retrieval when processing.
        wait: Wait for processing to finish (default True).

    Returns:
        ToolResponse describing the request and, when waited, the response.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the task does not exist or the comment is empty.
    """
    comment = (comment or "").strip()
    if not comment:
        raise ValueError("comment is required to request changes")

    chat = _find_task(chat_manager, chat_id)
    if chat is None:
        raise ValueError(f"task '{chat_id}' not found")

    _append_comment(
        chat_manager=chat_manager,
        chat=chat,
        content=comment,
        role=role or REQUEST_CHANGES_ROLE,
        profiles=profiles,
        files=files,
        username=username,
    )
    _emit(
        event_manager=event_manager,
        chat=chat,
        message=f"Changes requested on task '{chat.name}'",
        event_type="changed",
    )

    async def _run() -> None:
        """Run the engine and persist the resulting chat."""
        try:
            await processing_session.chat_with_project(
                chat=chat, disable_knowledge=disable_knowledge
            )
        finally:
            try:
                chat_manager.save_chat(chat=chat)
            except Exception as ex:
                logger.warning(
                    "project_manager: could not persist processed task '%s': %s",
                    chat.id, ex,
                )

    if wait:
        await _run()
        result_preview = _latest_assistant_content(chat)
        user_lines = [
            f"✅ Changes requested on task **{chat.name}** and processed.",
            f"- ID: `{chat.id}`",
            f"- Status: `{chat.status or '-'}`",
            f"- Messages: {len(chat.messages)}",
        ]
        if result_preview:
            user_lines.extend(["", "**Latest response**", result_preview])
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="\n".join(user_lines),
            llm_response=_json(
                {"status": "processed", "task_id": chat.id,
                 "response": result_preview, "task": _task_dict(chat)}
            ),
        )

    task = asyncio.ensure_future(_run())
    _BACKGROUND_TASKS.add(task)

    def _done(future: "asyncio.Future") -> None:
        _BACKGROUND_TASKS.discard(future)
        if future.cancelled():
            return
        error = future.exception()
        if error is not None:
            logger.exception("project_manager: background processing error: %s", error)

    task.add_done_callback(_done)

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: queued background processing for task '%s'", chat.id
    )
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response=(
            f"⏳ Changes requested on task **{chat.name}**; processing started "
            "in the background."
        ),
        llm_response=_json({"status": "queued", "task_id": chat.id}),
    )


def _action_request_help(
    chat_manager,
    event_manager,
    chat_id: str,
    comment: str,
    role: Optional[str],
    profiles: Any,
    files: Any,
    username: Optional[str],
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Add a comment to a task WITHOUT triggering the engine (ask for help).

    Args:
        chat_manager: The project ChatManager.
        event_manager: Event manager used to notify the UI (may be None).
        chat_id: Task/chat id.
        comment: The help request / note (required).
        role: Comment role (defaults to ``assistant``).
        profiles: Profiles to stamp on the comment.
        files: Files to stamp on the comment.
        username: Author username.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse confirming the comment was recorded.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the task does not exist or the comment is empty.
    """
    comment = (comment or "").strip()
    if not comment:
        raise ValueError("comment is required to request help")

    chat = _find_task(chat_manager, chat_id)
    if chat is None:
        raise ValueError(f"task '{chat_id}' not found")

    message = _append_comment(
        chat_manager=chat_manager,
        chat=chat,
        content=comment,
        role=role or REQUEST_HELP_ROLE,
        profiles=profiles,
        files=files,
        username=username,
    )
    _emit(
        event_manager=event_manager,
        chat=chat,
        message=f"Help requested on task '{chat.name}' (no processing)",
        event_type="changed",
    )

    logger.info(
        "project_manager: help comment added to task '%s' (message=%s)",
        chat.id, message.doc_id,
    )
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response=(
            f"📝 Comment added to task **{chat.name}**.\n"
            f"- ID: `{chat.id}`\n"
            "- No processing was triggered: the request waits for a user."
        ),
        llm_response=_json(
            {"status": "comment_added", "task_id": chat.id,
             "message_id": message.doc_id, "processed": False}
        ),
    )
